summary: Student engineer with experience in competitive robotics, CAD, additive manufacturing, embedded systems, Rust, TypeScript, and machine learning. I have worked with VEX V5 systems from design and programming through fabrication, testing, and technical documentation.

bullets: Helped expand the robotics program from approximately 12 students across two teams to 24 students across four teams.
Oversee organizational planning, finances, resources, and technical programs while helping newer members become independent builders.
Help lead club operations and build a stronger competitive, analytical chess community at Garces.
Direct technical planning, robot software, design review, build coordination, and engineering documentation.
Support member development in mechanism design, construction, testing, and debugging.
Programmed and designed the competition robot; supported teammates with mechanism development and construction.
Developed season software in Rust with vexide and maintained team code through the GMHS Robotics organization.
Manage slicing, print setup, troubleshooting, and repeatable part production for engineering work.
Use Autodesk Inventor, Fusion 360, Bambu Studio, and OrcaSlicer across design and fabrication.
Develop aviation knowledge, service, discipline, and leadership through the cadet program.

projects.name: The Chair
projects.label: Stardance Super Star project
projects.details: Motorized VEX V5 chair with an eight-motor differential drivetrain, custom CAD/3D-printed mounts, encoder-based steering feedback, telemetry planning, and safety controls. Recorded gearing errors, interference, wobble, rebuilt supports, and working revisions across 9 public devlogs and 23 logged hours.

projects.name: vexID
projects.label: ML + iOS + VEX inventory
projects.details: ML-assisted VEX V5 parts identification system. Expanded training data, added grouped inventory tags, improved tracking, fixed missing 3D mesh triangles, and moved AprilTag raycasts from an AR plane to the captured iOS mesh.

projects.name: sonai
projects.label: Rust/WASM text classifier
projects.details: Built a compact feature-based AI text detector in Rust, made training reproducible with seeded randomness, automated data download and model rebuilds, compiled inference to WASM, and published the crate.
